name: Thinkspace Projects
about_text: Thinkspace Projects is a Los Angeles gallery in the West Adams District, founded in 2005 by Andrew Hosner and L. Croskey. Since its start the gallery has built an international reputation as a leading voice for the New Contemporary Art Movement, a lowbrow-descended, figurative and pop-culture-inflected strain of art that emerged on the West Coast in the 1990s. Thinkspace represents artists ranging from emerging to established, and has expanded beyond its own space to curate exhibitions with museums and partner galleries in cities such as Berlin, Hong Kong, London, New York, Detroit, Chicago and Honolulu. It also produces murals worldwide and works with organizations like POW! WOW! and RAD Napa. The gallery describes itself as artist-focused, family-run, and committed to bridging street-level and institutional art contexts.
